intended_object: The algebra isomorphism A[G] ≅ A[x_i^{±1} : i ∈ σ] from the group algebra of an abelian group G to the multivariable Laurent polynomial algebra. It is induced by a coordinate isomorphism G ≅ ℤ^(σ) and sends the basis element at g to the Laurent monomial with exponent vector e(g). This reading comes from the docstring, the module documentation and the companion `_single` lemma in the same file.
explanation: The body first undoes AddMonoidAlgebra.toMultiplicativeAlgEquiv, turning MonoidAlgebra A (Multiplicative G) back into AddMonoidAlgebra A G. It then applies AddMonoidAlgebra.domCongr A A e to reach AddMonoidAlgebra A (σ →₀ ℤ). In this library MvLaurentPolynomial σ A is an abbreviation for exactly AddMonoidAlgebra A (σ →₀ ℤ), the standard model of multivariable Laurent polynomials. So the composite is the isomorphism induced by e, and the `_single` lemma confirms that single (ofAdd g) a goes to single (e g) a. Mathlib at this commit has no MvLaurentPolynomial and no specialised version of this map. The general building block, AddMonoidAlgebra.domCongr, is what the definition uses, specialised to the Laurent target on purpose. Requiring AddCommGroup G costs nothing, since any G with such an e is an abelian group. Taking a commutative semiring A as an algebra over itself, rather than an R-algebra, is only a cosmetic restriction.
